title: Solar-powered fans at bus stops and green roofs for commuter comfort
asked: Ms Lee Hui Ying asked whether the Ministry has considered installing solar-powered fans at bus stops to improve commuter comfort, given projections that 2026 may be among the hottest years on record, and if so, the feasibility findings, estimated costs and implementation plans.
response: Mr Baey Yam Keng said earlier LTA trials found fans had limited impact on ambient temperature in exposed bus stops and commuter feedback was unfavourable, so there are no plans to install solar-powered fans at bus stops. He said LTA will study other options including green roofs, which are done during scheduled bus stop refurbishment and in phases, with roof structures reinforced for weight and maintenance access. On overseas cooler bus stop concepts, he said options must be commercially viable and available, and the Spain example appeared to be an early-stage university research project requiring underground water piping for mist. He said future bus stop designs will consider factors including commuter comfort, bus visibility, maintenance and safety, and that heat resilience is something the ministry will look into.

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: LTA will continue to study other options to improve commuter comfort at bus stops, including the use of green roofs which can help lower the ambient temperature.

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng

key_points.quote: certain factors like shading from buildings and trees is still a factor that we have to overcome

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: It would be carried out in phases.

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: not just the comfort of commuters who are waiting there but also the practicality of sighting of buses coming ahead as well as maintenance, safety

key_points.quote: there is a cost element

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: the vegetation there also needs sunlight and water

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng

key_points.point: Green roof work will be done in tandem with the regular bus stop rejuvenation schedule.
key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: it will also be done in tandem with the regular schedule of bus stop rejuvenation
